sources.excerpt: Official Giardino homepage identifies Giardino Italian Restaurant in Springfield, Virginia.
Official contact page lists 8944 Burke Lake Rd, Springfield, VA 22151 and phone 703-425-1555.
Official linked main-menu PDF; Italian menu at Springfield address. PDF appears dated/older and is treated as current linked menu surface but possible stale artifact.
Official /menu route serves the same linked main-menu PDF.
Homepage-linked SliceLife ordering vendor for Springfield; inspected as linked ordering surface.
Inspected official site/navigation/menu for allergen, allergy, nutrition and ingredient terms; no matrix.
Inspected official menu PDFs including main menu, wine menu, and Menu-22822.pdf; no allergen/nutrition matrix.
Inspected linked SliceLife menu; no official allergen matrix or ingredient disclosure.
Targeted domain query for allergen/nutrition/ingredients/PDF found official menu surfaces but no matrix.
